newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: No bidding shortage seen for Colombia coal mine.
newsitem.headline: No bidding shortage seen for Colombia coal mine.

text.p: Major coal companies worldwide are all expected to place bids for the Colombian government's 50 percent stake in the sprawling Cerrejon Zona Norte coal mine, a spokesman for Chase Manhattan's Chase Securities unit said Wednesday.
He spoke after it was announced that a consortium comprised by Chase Securities and Salomon Brothers Inc had been selected as lead advisers on the government selloff of its interest in the mine.
Larry Gaffaney, a vice president in Chase Securities' Global Mining and Metals Group, told Reuters in a telephone interview from New York that it was "premature to identify any particular bidders."
